feeds.title: Center for Compassionate Leadership Blog
feeds.description: The mission of the Center for Compassionate Leadership is to advance compassionate methods of leadership by integrating best practices of modern leadership, evidence-based science, and contemplative wisdom. We envision a more compassionate, peaceful world where individuals are able to express their full, innate potential for the greater good of all.

feeds.title: My Best Self 101 Blog
feeds.description: This website is dedicated to the science and personal application of the 'greatest hits' of positive psychology and mindfulness practices. You'll learn how to apply research-based principles to enhance the strengths and virtues that promote human thriving and nurture your love for life. It's the integration of timeless wisdom and modern empirical inquiry; the best of the East and West, personalized to your real life, to help you create your best self.

feeds.title: Teaching Balance Blog
feeds.description: Teaching Balance is about incorporating mindfulness into your everyday life so you can truly embody these qualities. Through my blog posts, workshops, Mindfulness Membership, and personal coaching, I address the different challenges teachers face and how to use mindfulness to best engage with those challenges. I help hard-working teachers manage their stress, integrate mindfulness and meditation into their lives, and find the balance that allows them to be at their best.

feeds.title: Resilience Psychotherapy Blog
feeds.description: Resilience's psychological and counseling services in Vancouver, Toronto, and Montreal are founded on developing awareness of ourselves. Mindfulness practice is an essential first step to therapy because it allows you to turn your attention inwards and uncover what is there. We model these skills in our interactions and help you cultivate them within yourself.
